title: aniba citrifolia
intro: Aniba citrifolia, commonly known as Wild Lime or Camu Camu, is a tropical plant species belonging to the Lauraceae family. The plant is rich in health benefits, including its ability to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent, which may help to protect against cell damage and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Aniba citrifolia include its potential to support the immune system, improve cognitive function, and exhibit anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
